title: Smaller, more frequent Pollen refills
summary:
Hourly Pollen refills for Spore and Seed, a calmer Models page, and fewer failed small-image requests.

Spore and Seed grants changed to hourly refills, while other tiers keep their existing schedules. Refills now add Pollen up to a tier’s cap rather than resetting the balance, and account responses include the next refill time when a tier has one. Balance checks also prevent requests whose estimated cost exceeds available Pollen.

The Models page replaced its expanding categories with tabs and responsive cards, avoiding the scroll jumps that came with the old layout. Fetching more model stats also fills in per-Pollen estimates that previously appeared as dashes. The README’s news and app showcase got their regular refresh.

Vertex AI image requests no longer use the unsupported 0.5K size. Supported 512×512 nanobanana requests now select 1K instead of returning a 400 error, with broader image-generation tests covering dimensions and image-to-image requests.

highlights.title: Browse models without the jumps
highlights.text: The Models page now uses category tabs and responsive cards instead of expanding sections, so comparing models no longer sends the page jumping. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
